name: hexkit
title: Hexkit
description: Run Hexkit developer tools from Raycast — JSON, JWT, hashing, encoders and more, with one-key fallback to the desktop app.
author: trinvh

preferences.name: hexkitCliPath
preferences.title: Hexkit CLI path
preferences.description: Path to the `hexkit` binary. Leave as `hexkit` if it's on your PATH.

preferences.name: licenseKey
preferences.title: License key
preferences.description: Hexkit Pro license key (optional today, required for Pro features in the future).
